description:
Jim from @AcademyApologia joins me to discuss the heretical atonement theory of the Seventh-Day Adventist Church which not only includes an ongoing, second phase of atonement in heaven that supposedly began in 1844, but that, ultimately, Satan will function as the scapegoat that removes sin from the universe. Is this just an alternate atonement theory or is it a complete heresy that totally altars and changes the gospel?
